metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, you got lucky AGAIN?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a freebie kill?
Enemy probably rebooting their whole setup.
Valorant logic handing out surprises like candy.
Click if your aim’s just pretending to work!

Tap if your kills are always ‘Wait, how?’ moments!
